map.Ra 轮廓算术平均偏差 (μm): Ra arithmetic mean deviation of profile (μm)
map.轮廓算术平均偏差，最常用粗糙度指标。: Arithmetic mean deviation of the profile, the most common roughness index.
map.微观不平度十点高度（5 个取样长度内最大峰谷高度平均），约为 Ra 的 4~7: Ten-point height of micro-unevenness (average of the largest peak-valley heights within 5 sampling lengths), about 4-7 times Ra.
map.轮廓最大高度，约为 Rz 的 1.2~1.6 倍。: Maximum height of profile, about 1.2-1.6 times Rz.
map.ISO 粗糙度等级代号（N1~N12），数值越大越粗糙。: ISO roughness-grade code (N1-N12); the larger the value, the rougher.
map.换算为经验近似，实际因加工方法与表面形貌而异。: The conversion is an empirical approximation and varies in practice by machining method and surface topography.

map.Ra=1.6μm 对应 Rz ≈ 1.6×1.4 ≈ 2.24μm（本档比值约: Ra=1.6μm corresponds to Rz ≈ 1.6×1.4 ≈ 2.24μm (ratio about 1.4 here); Ra=0.8 is mostly fine grinding, Ra=3.2 is rough milling.
map.Ra 12.5 粗车即可、Ra 3.2 精铣、Ra 1.6 精磨、Ra 0.4: Ra 12.5 needs only rough turning, Ra 3.2 fine milling, Ra 1.6 fine grinding, Ra 0.4 and below need lapping or polishing; choose by fit precision to avoid over-machining.
map.Ra 和 Rz 区别？: What is the difference between Ra and Rz?
map.Ra 是轮廓算术平均偏差，Rz 是最大峰谷高；同一表面 Rz≈4–7×Ra，Rz: Ra is the arithmetic mean deviation of the profile, Rz is the maximum peak-valley height; for the same surface Rz≈4-7×Ra, and Rz is more sensitive to sharp peaks.
map.越低加工成本指数上升；按功能选，密封/滑动面需低 Ra，非配合面粗一点更经济。: The lower the value, the higher the processing-cost index; choose by function - sealing / sliding surfaces need low Ra, non-fitting surfaces can be rougher for economy.
